compression_rule: This capability SHALL remain independently meaningful and SHALL NOT be reduced to a generic Observer label.
distinctive_invariant: External context may pressure analysis without acquiring primary-evidence status or collection authority.
evidence_rule: Observer output SHALL remain evidence-bounded and SHALL NOT silently strengthen uncertainty, visibility, or claim status.
provenance_rule: Every material result SHALL remain attributable to Observer identity, operation identity, bound Room/revision/view, evidence references, applicable ceiling, and disposition.
purpose: Apply bounded external-context or OSINT-style contextual pressure using only explicitly supplied or separately permitted external context.
questions: Does supplied external context materially pressure the bounded claim?
What changes if the supplied external context is considered without promoting it to primary evidence?
Does contextual comparison expose an unresolved condition?
